label: Outreachy
source: outreachy.org internship-round pages, held at public/data/otherProjects.json (program "Outreachy")
note: One row per internship Outreachy lists on its round pages, reshaped from /data/otherProjects.json. `t` is the project title exactly as the round page prints it and `url` is that page's anchor for it (437 of 437 rows carry one). `s` is the round, recovered from the round slug Outreachy itself puts in the URL. `o` is the community name as Outreachy abbreviates it (e.g. "ASF"), so the `orgs` rollup is keyed by that name rather than a GitHub login; the current call-for-participation list of communities is a separate document at /data/outreachy-communities.json. Outreachy's round pages name no mentor per project, so `m` stays empty - the organization-level mentors this site holds in /data/mentor-index.json are deliberately not pasted onto internship rows, because that would claim a named person mentored a specific internship we never read a mentor for.
